name: Kage Gallery
description: A quiet, typographic portfolio theme for a small contemporary art gallery showing painting, works on paper and small sculpture in a white room by the river. Wall white and stone grey, charcoal text, a muted bronze kept to frames, hairlines and large marks, and a deeper bronze for links and small labels; Gelasio for the oversized titles and text, Inter Tight for dates, wall labels and the menu. A white-cube bar with only the wordmark and a Menu button opens a full-screen pale-wall menu with large Gelasio items and the visit details beside them (H4). The home page sets the current exhibition title very large over white space, then a ruled line of dates and artist and the wall text, a calm row of four works with wall labels, the next exhibitions, the visit details and the journal (L9). Works carry a fine shadow edge, as if hung. The footer is one hairline row of visit details and slim links (F3). With Exhibitions (now on view, upcoming, past), Artists, Visit, About, Journal, Newsletter and Contact. The visit details, the current exhibition and the upcoming exhibitions are each one synced pattern, edited once.

summary.zh-TW: 留白而安靜的當代藝廊網站，以超大襯線字呈現當期展覽。
summary.en: A quiet white-cube design for a small contemporary art gallery and its exhibitions.
summary.ja: 小さな現代アートギャラリーのための、余白の多い静かなホワイトキューブのデザイン。
summary.fr: Un design calme et épuré de white cube pour une petite galerie d'art contemporain.
summary.de: Ein ruhiges White-Cube-Design für eine kleine Galerie für zeitgenössische Kunst.

deviation: none for the header, footer and layout codes (H4 / F3 / L9 as planned). Colours as planned (wall #FAFAF8, stone #E4E4E0, charcoal #1C1C1B, muted bronze #8B7B5C) plus: deep bronze #6B5C3F for links, labels, badges and keys (6.2:1 on wall, 5.1:1 on stone), quiet grey #64645F for secondary text, wall labels and dates (5.7:1 on wall, 4.7:1 on stone) and a decorative hairline #D3D2CC (rules and shadow edges only, no text). Charcoal is 16.3:1 on wall and 13.4:1 on stone. Muted bronze #8B7B5C is 3.95:1 on wall and 3.24:1 on stone, so it is used only for the badge line, the current-menu-item underline, the footer dots and frames, never for small text. Gelasio has no light weight (its range is 400-700), so the oversized title is Gelasio Regular with tight tracking rather than a thin cut.

fonts.role: wordmark, oversized exhibition titles, headings, menu items and body text
fonts.source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/gelasio (variable wght; OFL.txt checked: no Reserved Font Name, so instanced to weights 400-600 (italic 400-500) and subset to Latin as WOFF2, 35 KB each)

fonts.role: dates, wall labels, the Menu button, keys, badges, buttons and the footer
fonts.source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/intertight (variable wght 100-900; OFL.txt checked: no Reserved Font Name; the same Latin WOFF2 subset as Kenchiku Grid, 44 KB)
